description: OmniClaude Core Hooks - OMN-13244 measurement baseline with the OMN-13856, OMN-14330, OMN-15062, OMN-15213, OMN-16277, and OMN-16162 carve-outs. Every context-injection/measurement hook stays DISABLED; the only re-registered hooks are the Done-flip durable-evidence guard (OMN-13856, operator-approved, no fake Done), the OMN-7018 worktree canonical-root guard (OMN-14330, blocks `git worktree add` outside $OMNI_HOME/omni_worktrees), the SubagentStop secret-leak guard (OMN-15062, blocks a subagent's final report from completing when it matches a known secret pattern -- narrowly scoped security control), the SubagentStop report-contract guard (OMN-15213, fails a lane RED when its final return is bare-Done-class instead of the report the golden-chain contract requires), the PostToolUse Bash-output secret-redaction guard (OMN-16277, masks secret-shaped patterns in raw Bash tool_response text via hookSpecificOutput.updatedToolOutput before it lands in the transcript -- narrowly scoped security control, same class as OMN-15062, NOT a re-enable of the disabled context-injection/measurement hooks), and the SessionStart/SessionEnd bus-mirror hooks (OMN-16162, direct-dispatch a session-started/session-ended event to omnimarket's node_event_emit_effect, backgrounded and fail-open -- the local-bus-mirror transport superseding the OMN-16090 HTTP spool-shipper stopgap). None of these re-registrations is a re-enable of the disabled context-injection/measurement hooks. All other scripts remain on disk and re-registration stays a pure config change.
